title: Obere Riedstraße, Mannheim
description:
Die exklusive, 2-Zimmer-Wohnung ist mit sorgfältig ausgewählten Möbeln eingerichtet. Sie liegt im zweiten Stock eines 1900 erbauten und weitestgehend original erhaltenen Jugendstilbaus im beliebten Viertel Käfertal.

description:

title: Dr.-Heinrich-Winter-Straße, Heppenheim (Bergstraße)
description:
A newly renovated, modern, fully furnished, and equipped penthouse apartment with high ceilings is available for rent in the tallest building in the area. Surrounded by nature in Heppenheim and offering breathtaking views, this apartment was completed under the supervision of an architect to ensure a space where anyone can feel instantly at home.

Living Space & Interior
The modern apartment impresses with an open floor plan, high ceilings, and a bright, welcoming atmosphere. The spacious living and dining area with an open-plan kitchen offers direct access to the south-facing rooftop terrace. From here, you can enjoy unique views of the adjacent Bruchsee recreation area and the surrounding vineyards.

Kitchen: Fully equipped with a dishwasher, induction stove, oven, fridge-freezer, coffee machine, kettle, toaster, and all necessary cutlery and utensils.

Living Area: Features ample storage via a large built-in wardrobe, a modern sofa, a 55-inch TV, and high-speed internet. Practical extras like a vacuum cleaner, iron, and ironing board are also provided.

Sleeping Area: A separately designed area featuring a comfortable boxspring bed, complete with linens, pillows, and a wardrobe/chest of drawers.

Home Office: An integrated workspace with a desk, chairs, and an ergonomic sitting ball—ideal for remote work.

Bathroom: A modernized daylight bathroom with a spacious walk-in shower. Towels and a hairdryer are included.

Amenities & Building Features
In-Unit Laundry: A washer-dryer is located directly within the apartment.

Security & Parking: Features a modern video intercom system and smoke detectors. A shared parking space on the property is included in the rent.

Wellness: Residents have access to two large elevators, a swimming pool, and a sauna within the building.

Storage: A ground-level, locked bicycle storage room and shared outdoor areas are available.

Customization: Personalization of the mailbox and doorbell labels is permitted.

Prime Location
The property is located directly next to the Bruchsee nature reserve and the Heppenheim District Hospital.

Transit: 5-minute walk to the train station; 3-minute drive to the A5 motorway.

Local Charm: The "fairytale" historic town center of Heppenheim is just a further 5-minute walk away.

Commuting: Easy access to Darmstadt, Heidelberg, Frankfurt, and Mannheim.

Rental Details
Perfectly suited for a single professional or a couple, this "hidden gem" is waiting for its very first tenant.

Monthly Rent: All-inclusive ("Warmmiete"), covering all utilities, electricity, and internet.
